title: Better antibodies, better science
content:
by Johan Duchêne

Poorly validated antibodies generate misleading results and waste research resources. Two new studies in PLOS Biology quantify the ethical costs of this issue, examine why unvalidated antibodies are still used, and identify solutions to reduce their use.
